_doc: Exact allowlist of test_kernel_backend_imports.py: the backend SDK imports in src/sandloom/core outside core/drivers that stay. A new (file, sdk) or a higher count fails, and so does a stale entry (fewer sites than listed, or none). reason says why the site stays. The scan covers src/sandloom/core (outside core/drivers and unit tests), src/sandloom/sdk and src/sandloom/shared.

entries.reason: stays: `sandloom dev` pings and inspects the developer's own Redis server through the client when the `redis` extra installed it; imported by name inside `except ImportError` (no client: the check stops at a TCP connect). The kernel wheel requires no Redis client (tools/packaging/check_package_distributions.py KERNEL_GUARDED_REDIS)
